lines.text: Without love, tongues make one a clanging cymbal, and prophecy and faith to move the sea make one nothing.
Love is patient and kind, does not envy or boast, keeps no account of wrongs, and rejoices in the truth.
Love never fails, but prophecies will cease, and the partial passes away when the perfect comes.
Childish ways were set aside at manhood, and now we see a dim reflection but will see face to face.
The three things that remain are faith, hope and joy.
